summary.text: Joe Fitzgibbon is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 34-Position 2 since 2011 and serving as House majority leader since January 2023, who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Mary Anito.

paragraphs.text: Joe Fitzgibbon earned a B.A. in history and political science from Principia College and attended the University of Washington's Evans School of Public Affairs.
Before his election, he worked as a legislative assistant in the House from 2007 to 2010 and was a legislative intern for the King County Council in 2007.
Fitzgibbon assumed office in the Washington House in 2011 and has served as majority leader since January 9, 2023.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he previously chaired the House Environment & Energy Committee and named the Climate Commitment Act and the Clean Fuel Standard among his achievements.

In the same survey, Fitzgibbon said his highest priority is delivering a balanced and sustainable budget that invests in education, health care, child care and public safety, and he also named climate change and housing supply as priorities.
